headline: Bitcoin Plunges Below $60,000 Amid ETF Outflows and Risk-Off Sentiment
summary: Bitcoin traded more than 50% below its highs and dropped below the $60,000 barrier, pressured by heavy capital outflows from spot exchange-traded funds during a severe monthly slump.
why: Cryptocurrency markets are highly sensitive to ETF fund flows and broader macro risk sentiment, with capital withdrawals triggering sharp liquidations.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Persistent ETF outflows reduce institutional demand and drive down digital asset prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Sustained capital outflows from spot exchange-traded funds combined with general risk aversion drove widespread liquidations across digital asset markets.
